## About
New Image Auto Solutions is an auto body shop on Melrose Ave in Silver Lake. We do collision repair, paintless dent removal, paint and color matching, mechanical repair, window tinting and detailing, all under one roof.
An accident is stressful enough. We walk you through the whole repair, from towing and rental car setup to working with your insurance adjuster, and we treat your car like it's our own.
Customers know Izzy, the owner, and his business partner Betsy by name, along with Linda, who keeps you posted while your car is in the shop. We're rated 4.7 from 108 Google reviews.

## Services
- Auto body and collision repair: Body and collision repair after an accident.
- Paintless dent removal: Dent removal without repainting.
- Paint and color matching: Paint work matched to faded or weathered paint.
- Mechanical repair: Mechanical work alongside body repair, so the whole job stays in one shop.
- Exhaust and muffler: Exhaust and muffler work for your car.
- Window tinting and auto detailing: Window tint and detailing.
- Lease return makeovers: Get your leased car looking right before you turn it in.

## FAQ
Q: Which insurance companies do you work with?
A: We work with all auto insurance companies, and with customers paying out of pocket too.

Q: Can I get an estimate without coming in?
A: Yes. We can give you a rough estimate by email, or come to your home or office for an estimate.

Q: Do you work on hybrids and electric cars?
A: Yes. We work on hybrids like the Toyota Prius and electric cars like Tesla.
